comment: 1.0.0: from 0.9.3. Icons no longer stay away: the census has no upper end (25868 units was 'not measured'), is re-read until it stops growing and piles past 300 m make a map big; notches within 0.3 s of a step are ignored as the game ignores them; a level still unsure after 0.8 s draws at -1. Map Icon Opacity, World Pin Opacity, Closer Zooms Helper (the mod's folder holds the companion, started once with the game).
title: Treasure Radar

manifest.//: its own Guid and Name, not 0.5.1's: HD2ModManager finds mods by Guid (with 0.5.1 still installed it deployed 0.5.1 for a ticked 0.6.0) and stores them in a folder named after Name, so a name of its own keeps clear of other authors' Treasure Radar 0.6.0. The title (in the addon and the log) stays Treasure Radar

set.Name: Awmer Treasure Radar {version}
set.Description: Loot, objectives and structures on the game's own map in the game's own style, at all three zoom levels, with a legend of what's left; a small radar while the map is closed, the nearest valuables on the compass and pins over loot near you. Tick it and play, at any resolution. The whole map needs nothing else; the two closer zooms use a small helper program in the mod's folder that starts with the game and can be turned off in the options. Has its own loader built in (log: treasure_radar.log in %LOCALAPPDATA%), so don't use it with another mod that replaces boot, or with another Awmer Treasure Radar build. Based on Treasure Radar by Th3chef.

options.Name: Awmer Treasure Radar
options.Description: Everything is on with good defaults: loot, objectives and structures on the game's map (Tab) at all three zoom levels, with a legend of what's left; a small radar in the corner while the map is closed, the nearest valuables on the game's compass, pins over loot near you, and a ping helper. Keep this ticked; the boxes and lists below only change a default. Keys: F7 hides or shows the mod, Numpad 1 sets or clears a waypoint of your own on what you look at, Numpad 3 clears them.

options.Name: Closer Zooms Helper
options.Description: The icons at the two closer map zooms need to know where the game's map is looking, which the game doesn't tell mods. For that the mod starts a small program from its own folder when the game starts. It reads the map from the game's window, keeps everything on this PC, sends nothing anywhere, and exits with the game. Off, the icons show on the whole map only, as exact as ever.

SubOptions.Name: Start it with the game
SubOptions.Description: Default. Starts the small program from the mod's folder once per game run; it reads the map from the game's window, stays on this PC and exits with the game.

SubOptions.Name: Off: whole map only
SubOptions.Description: Starts nothing. The mod's icons show with the map zoomed all the way out.
